## About
Air Zone Experts is a family-owned HVAC company based in Little Elm, run by Adrian and Cristina Racovei. We fix, replace and install air conditioning and heating for homeowners and businesses across Denton, Collin and Dallas counties, from Frisco and The Colony to Prosper and McKinney.
Adrian is NATE-certified and goes out on service calls, diagnostics and installations himself. We give you an upfront price before any work begins, and the quote you agree to is the price on the final invoice.
We service all makes and models, and we're an authorized Trane dealer. Our neighbors have given us a 5 rating across 425 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours too.

## Services
- Air Conditioning Repair: Fast, reliable AC repair with expert diagnostics and transparent pricing.
- Air Conditioning Replacement: High-efficiency replacement systems that lower energy costs and improve indoor comfort.
- Air Conditioning Installation: Energy-efficient systems with expert setup for reliable, long-lasting cooling.
- Air Duct Services: Complete air duct repair and replacement to improve efficiency and indoor air quality.
- Heater Repair: Repair for furnace failures and no heat situations, so your home stays warm through the colder months.
- Heater Replacement: Energy-efficient furnace replacement that can reduce utility bills and improve heating performance.
- Maintenance and Tune Up: Heating system maintenance and tune-ups to improve efficiency and extend equipment life.

## FAQ
Q: Does the owner come out on service calls?
A: Yes. Adrian Racovei personally handles a lot of our service calls, diagnostics and installations, so you get honest recommendations from the owner.

Q: What brands do you work on?
A: All major brands, including Trane, Carrier, Lennox and Rheem. We service all makes and models, and we're an authorized Trane dealer.

Q: Do you offer emergency service?
A: Yes. We offer emergency HVAC service when your heating or cooling fails unexpectedly. Give us a call and we'll tell you how soon we can get there.

Q: Do you work on commercial properties?
A: Yes. We serve both homeowners and business owners throughout Denton, Collin and Dallas counties.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. We offer flexible financing options for qualifying customers, including low monthly payment plans and same-as-cash options.
